He has been to 10 Starship launches, shooting since flight 2, and his camera rig gets more elaborate every single time.

On this one, the GoPros did not fire in time and he lost the footage. So he is already mapping out how to set them up differently for the next launch. That is what 10 trips of trial and error looks like in practice.
